NHL EDGE stats behind McDavid’s historic start for Oilers
Trophy Tracker: Bouchard of Oilers choice for Norris as top defenseman
NHL On Tap: McDavid on 22-game run for streaking Oilers

out.detail: injured (undisclosed), expected to miss third consecutive game

away.summary: The Oilers (17-3-3) are riding a five-game win streak and sit atop the NHL standings, led by Connor McDavid's 22-game point streak and Leon Draisaitl's league-leading 20 goals. They will be without several key players, including forwards Ryan Nugent-Hopkins and Mattias Janmark, defensemen Jake Walman and Alec Regula, and goaltender Frederik Andersen. Devon Levi is projected to start in goal ahead of Tristan Jarry, with Max Jones also among the scratches.

injured (upper body), placed on IR, likely to miss extended time

home.summary: The Lightning (14-5-2) are missing forwards Brandon Hagel and Conor Geekie to IR, with Zemgus Girgensons also day to day. Defensemen Max Crozier and Jansen Harkins are scratched, though Harkins was recently recalled from Syracuse. Andrei Vasilevskiy is projected to start in goal over Dennis Hildeby as Tampa Bay hosts the streaking Oilers.
